scope: TG2 frozen processor API compatibility and pre-step output isolation only

observations.v6_result: Transformers 5.2 correctly loaded Qwen3-VL and built the full model, but the first DataLoader batch failed before optimizer step 0 because the frozen collator's processor_kwargs padding flag was not forwarded to the Qwen3 tokenizer.
observations.cross_version_probe: Transformers 4.57.6 reproduced the same variable-length tensor failure, ruling out a 5.x-only batching regression.
observations.validated_fix: A sitecustomize compatibility bridge forwards the frozen processor_kwargs.padding value as the top-level ProcessorMixin.apply_chat_template padding argument. The unchanged frozen call then batched two unequal-length multimodal prompts into a tensor successfully.
observations.pre_step_output_audit: Eight v5 output directories contained only config.json and config.yaml and no checkpoint, optimizer state, trainer state, metric, or completed step. They were preserved with suffix .runtime_v5_pre_step0_quarantine before retry.

changes: Load the v3 overlay containing the three v6 Hugging Face packages plus the narrow processor_kwargs.padding compatibility bridge.
Verify the compatibility bridge hash and execute an unequal-length two-message padding smoke before the frozen runner.
Tag scheduler attempts with runtime revision v7 so pre-step failures from v6 and earlier revisions cannot consume the v7 retry budget.
invariants: The frozen TG2 runner, collator, model code, data, checkpoint, arms, seeds, optimizer settings, global batch, training steps, and completion selection remain unchanged.
The bridge only forwards the already-requested padding=True value; it rejects any other processor_kwargs key.
No failed output was deleted or reused, and no v5/v6 attempt reached optimizer step 0.
TG1A and TG1B remain on runtime amendment v4 and are not rearmed by this amendment.
